name: SPT-CL J0044-4037 (Webb)
blurb: SPT-CL J0044-4037, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Webb.
label: sptclj00444037-webb
story: A massive cluster of galaxies, picked out through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect. Webb imaged it to see how galaxies falling into a cluster build up the bright galaxy at its center.

claims.text: SPT-CLJ0044-4037 is one of the 182 massive galaxy clusters in Webb survey program 5594
The clusters were picked from Sunyaev-Zel'dovich cluster candidates (SPT, ACT and Planck) and X-ray catalogs
The survey tracks billions of years of cluster growth
Science goals: how infalling galaxies build the bright central galaxy, how dark matter is distributed and tidally stripped from sub-halos, and strong lensing
SPT clusters are found in South Pole Telescope data through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
